newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P rates Western Australia Treasury bonds AA.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Western Australia Treasury bonds AA.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp (S&P) said on Thursday it had assigned its AA rating to 10 billion yen worth of six percent yen/Australian dollar dual-currency bonds issued by Western Australia Treasury Corp.
The bonds are due on September 29, 1998.
S&P said it had also assigned its AA rating to 15 billion yen worth of 5.7 percent yen/Australian dollar dual currency bonds from the same issuer, due on February 16, 1998.
It also assigned its AA rating to 20 billion yen worth of 6.5 percent yen/Australian dollar dual-currency bonds issued by the corporation due on April 16, 1998, it said.
S&P said the outlook for all three issues was positive.
